alt: A stunning four-tiered wedding cake features textured white frosting with a gradient of soft pink hues cascading from the base to delicate blush near the top, adorned with golden leaf decorations and small dark accents that resemble seeds or berries, creating an elegant, organic design.

A four-tiered wedding cake features a marbled fondant finish in soft pastel shades of lavender and white, each tier adorned with sugar flowers in varying shades of purple and white including roses and other blossoms interspersed with green leaves, crowned with a decorative topper of intertwined hearts and set on a square purple base.

An intricately sculpted five-tiered wedding cake designed to resemble stacked birch tree logs resting on a mossy forest floor, each tier mimicking peeling papery bark with characteristic white surface and dark lenticels, decorated with delicate sugar flowers in blush pink, peach, sky blue, and pale yellow, with a hand-drawn heart containing the initials "E & N" on the second-lowest tier.

A three-tiered winter-themed cake features white fondant decorated with embossed snowflakes and pine branches, a middle tier painted with a blue birch forest scene, and piped sugar pine trees dusted with white "snow" on the top and bottom tiers, illuminated by blue LED lights underneath the upper layer.
A three-tiered yellow cake features intricate, hand-painted botanical designs with green leaves, red berries, and colorful flowers on each level.

A three-tiered wedding cake decorated in red, black, and white features a baseball theme, including a Cortland Red Dragons cap at the base, jersey numbers 6 and 27 on the middle tier, and a bride and groom figurine on top.
A three-tiered cake decorated with vibrant yellow and red patterns, black bead accents, and topped with realistic-looking cacti and succulents.
This elaborate two-tiered cake is decorated with a painted forest scene, faux moss, rocks, and purple crystal clusters, featuring a central waterfall cascading down the middle tier.
A four-tiered white wedding cake decorated with intricate piped icing and adorned with a cascade of pale pink roses and green leaves.
An ornate, multi-tiered cake with gold and bronze filigree detailing and jeweled accents is topped with a vibrant blue peacock figurine.
An elaborate, multi-tiered cake decorated with a winter theme features two white owls perched on birch tree branches, surrounded by snowy landscapes, pink flowers, and a miniature open book.
A tall, sculpted birch tree centerpiece with green leaves and a rocky base decorated with blue flowers sits on a table inside a white tent, accompanied by wooden letters spelling "Love is Sweet."
A four-tiered wedding cake features textured white frosting with sweeping bands of pink and red icing, adorned with cascading gold leaf decorations that spiral from the top tier down to the base.
